title: Rubric core: schema/loader/version split + invariant placement
rationale: trellis-2304 implements SPEC §6.1 rubric WHAT layer in src/rubric/ as three modules: schema.ts (zod per-record shape + cross-FIELD invariants), loader.ts (fs read + cross-RECORD invariants), version.ts (RUBRIC_VERSION + comparable()). Key decisions: (1) per-record invariants that need only the record live in zod via .superRefine — investigation non-null IFF discoveryVia=agent; weight via z.number().positive(); reserved gate/weight use .default(false)/.default(1) so YAML may omit them. (2) z.strictObject (not z.object) to reject typo'd keys; dropped .brand() to avoid zod v4 type friction with defaults+superRefine. (3) Cross-record invariants live in loader.ts because they need the whole set or the source file: scope-matches-file, unique ids (criteria deduped ACROSS both scope files via a shared Map), category refs resolve, exactly-one-gate-per-category. (4) RubricError(message,id,file) — every throw names offending id+file; schema failures map zod issues to a path:message string and recover the id best-effort via idOf(). (5) loadRubric(dir=import.meta.dir) reads the 3 YAML files; tests use temp dirs + fixtures (no fs mocks per convention) overriding a VALID baseline. (6) comparable() encodes SPEC §3.5: pre-1.0 comparability rides the MINOR slot so differing 0.x minors are NOT comparable; post-1.0 only major breaks. Data files (categories/repo-scope/app-scope.yaml) are authored separately in trellis-db3d — loader works against fixtures until then. Also un-ignored zod/js-yaml/@types/js-yaml in knip.json now that they're imported.
